scope: source and local mocked headless fixture only; installed/native/model execution unverified

input.cursor: last accepted contiguous cursor, initially zero

first_page_witness: Protected current Side Chat source is available under the same view capture.
Protected owner Turn matches retained turn_id/conversation_id and supplies the accepted input_digest.
Current canonical user head/revision, user metadata.turn_id and exact draft match the retained ticket.
First protected progress page matches that turn/conversation/parent/revision/input digest.
Broker request_id and ai_input_digest come only from that authenticated first page; durable saved-turn request_id is not substituted.
capture_deadlines: Host-issued deadlines on the view, source and exact progress target can only shorten the original retained deadline during refresh. Page TTL is immutable and never renewed.
display: Append only actual text_delta in escaped plain text. All thinking_delta text is suppressed because this wire has no approved safe-summary provenance. Finish/provider_complete/canonical_turn_status do not provide a saved receipt or clear drafts.
canonical_completion: Existing owner receipt and canonical child history must agree before clearing the matching draft/ticket. Explicit reconcile remains available without automatic AI retry.
unavailable: Missing exact selected target, Host pure/read evidence, protected witness, current capture or valid unexpired page keeps live progress unavailable and preserves canonical recovery state.
integration_owner: ROOT adopts the optional Application frontend signed resource edge, finite input/output schemas, read effect/capability, Profile selection and canonical artifacts. This proposal cannot grant authority or readiness.

validation.external_traffic: blocked by the fixture; no provider, key, Docker or Native PackVM execution
